purpose: Review the existing photo-only X/Y photographic lineage from the exact raw pixels; preserve a small case-scoped lesson without touching typography, native state, or the production compiler.

actual_pixel_readback.method: Read source raw PNG from the linked authenticated Google Drive reference and X/Y raw PNGs materialized from the exact ChatGPT Library file IDs; independently recompute byte SHA256, pixel dimensions and broad vertical-strip RGB/HSV statistics.

prompt_lineage.X_prompt_design: one straightforward real reference task with limited scene and content constraints
prompt_lineage.Y_prompt_design: same baseline plus 8 visual controls for ivory sky, subdued peach ridge, fog-dominant depth, small lower-left road and car, diffuse ambient light, restrained ochre-stone colors, and haze occlusion

observed_photo_reading.reference: Upper pale near-ivory open sky; muted peach distant ridge; central low-contrast white cloud/fog bank, partly occluded gray hill islands; small winding road and tiny dark vehicle on warm dry lower-left slope. No asserted specific camera/lens or geography.
observed_photo_reading.X: Stronger orange-pink sky, dark forested and rock-heavy foreground, multiple crisp mountains, more prominent serpentine road and dense details. Overall visual spectacle and contrast are stronger than reference; specific user feedback flags AI-feel.
observed_photo_reading.Y: Near-ivory open sky, broad pale-peach ridge, mist as the largest middle mass, lower-left road with small dark car, softened interleaving hill shapes and understated matte tonality. Greater visual resemblance to the reference's restraint, without literal mountain-copy claim.
observed_photo_reading.direct_assistant_visual_judgment: Y is materially closer to the source photographic grammar than X. This is an assistant pixel review, not a second independent blinded human verdict.

vertical_band_hsv_saturation_percent.methodology: Mean HSV saturation (0 to 100 percent) computed per equally normalized vertical image band from actual RGB pixels. Reference and variants have different content geometry. Diagnostic only, not a perceptual quality score or causal explanation.

learned_case_scoped_mechanisms: Maintain high-key but neutral/ivory upper sky rather than saturated glowing sunset.
Make soft opaque/interleaved fog the main middle-distance mass; hills gain depth by occlusion rather than sharpened HDR silhouettes.
Keep the road narrow and subordinate to the landscape, with exactly one tiny car as a secondary scale cue.
Allow realistic dry warm foreground while avoiding dark forests, dramatic high-contrast rock mass, and sweeping postcard composition that dominate X.
Keep a limited set of concrete visible photographic controls in the image prompt; do not infer that a longer prompt, by itself, caused Y's preference.
uncertainty_and_safety: Only one X and one Y were generated; generator randomness and multiple concurrent prompt changes confound causal attribution.
Reference rights are UNKNOWN; original source reference is a third-party photograph and may not be treated as owned or commercially reusable.
The generated Y is relatively preferred but the existing record does not provide an unconditional FINAL/GOLDEN human approval.
Original generator back-end exact binding manifest and strict native 9:16 output are not verified.
No global aesthetic rule or skill candidate is authorized by this single case.

proposed_next_photo_only_action.principle: Use Y as the protected relative-best photographic comparison baseline; move to meaningfully different geography instead of re-rendering the same mountain scene. Retain sky/fog/scale grammar without tracing original landforms. Independently review new raw pixels for naturalism and visible family resemblance.
proposed_next_photo_only_action.gate: Require user direction or explicit one-image generation approval; verify rights of any external image physically supplied to the generator.
proposed_next_photo_only_action.if_exact_9_16_required: Record native output actual dimensions. Derive a separate non-destructive exact 9:16 crop only if requested; never change original-asset identity or call the original exact.
